english: It was a blessing in disguise.

meanings.translation1: Не было бы счастья, да несчастье помогло.
meanings.translation: Всё, что ни делается, — к лучшему.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real disguise — it means something bad that turns out to be good.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Речь не о маскировке — значит, что плохое обернулось хорошим.

english: Don't bite off more than you can chew.
transcription: [dəʊnt baɪt ɒf mɔː(r) ðæn juː kæn tʃuː]

meanings.translation1: Не бери на себя больше, чем можешь.
meanings.translation: Не хватай больше, чем можешь проглотить.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about food — it means don't take on more than you can handle.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о еде — значит не брать на себя слишком много.

english: Stop beating around the bush.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about bushes — it means avoiding the main topic.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Речь не о кустах — значит избегать главной темы.

english: He's burning the midnight oil.

meanings.translation: Он сидит за работой до ночи.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about burning oil — it means working late into the night.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о сжигании масла — значит работать до глубокой ночи.

english: I passed by the skin of my teeth.
transcription: [aɪ pɑːst baɪ ðə skɪn əv maɪ tiːθ]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about skin or teeth — it means only just succeeded.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о коже и зубах — значит едва-едва справиться.

english: Let sleeping dogs lie.

meanings.translation1: Не буди лихо, пока оно тихо.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about dogs — it means don't bring up old problems.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Речь не о собаках — значит не ворошить прошлое.

english: Don't throw in the towel.

meanings.exampleSentence: Comes from boxing — the towel means giving up, not a bath towel.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Пришло из бокса — полотенце означает сдачу, а не банное полотенце.

english: That's the last straw.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a straw — it means the final problem that makes you lose patience.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Речь не о соломинке — значит последняя капля терпения.

english: Don't cry over spilt milk.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about milk — it means don't waste time regretting what's done.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о молоке — значит не сожалеть о том, что уже случилось.

english: The ball is in your court.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a tennis ball — it means it's your turn to act.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о теннисном мяче — значит теперь твой ход.

english: He's sitting on the fence.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a fence — it means refusing to choose a side.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о заборе — значит не выбирать сторону.

english: I finally saw the light.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real light — it means finally understanding something.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о свете — значит наконец понять что-то.

english: He stole my thunder.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about lightning — it means taking credit for someone else's idea.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о громе — значит присвоить чужую идею.

english: She always goes the extra mile.

meanings.translation1: Она всегда делает больше, чем нужно.
meanings.translation: Она всегда старается изо всех сил.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about distance — it means doing more than expected.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о расстоянии — значит делать больше, чем ожидается.

english: He has years of experience under his belt.
transcription: [hiː hæz jɪəz əv ɪkˈspɪəriəns ˈʌndə(r) hɪz belt]

meanings.translation1: У него за плечами годы опыта.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a belt — it means accumulated experience.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о ремне — значит накопленный опыт.

english: You're barking up the wrong tree.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about dogs or trees — it means pursuing the wrong idea or person.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о собаках и деревьях — значит обратиться не к тому или ошибиться в идее.

english: Who let the cat out of the bag?
transcription: [huː let ðə kæt aʊt əv ðə bæɡ]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a cat — it means who revealed the secret.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о коте — значит кто раскрыл секрет.

english: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
transcription: [dəʊnt pʊt ɔːl jɔː eɡz ɪn wʌn ˈbɑːskɪt]

meanings.translation1: Не клади все яйца в одну корзину.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about eggs — it means don't risk everything on one thing.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о яйцах — значит не рисковать всем сразу.

english: When pigs fly!

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about pigs — it means something will never happen.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о свиньях — значит никогда не случится.

english: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
transcription: [ði ˈæpl ˈdʌznt fɔːl fɑː(r) frɒm ðə triː]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about apples — it means children resemble their parents.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о яблоках — значит дети похожи на родителей.

english: Don't burn your bridges.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about real bridges — it means don't destroy future opportunities.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о мостах — значит не разрушать будущие возможности.

english: Back to square one.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a board game square — it means starting over again.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о клетке на доске — значит начинать заново.

english: I'll cross that bridge when I come to it.
transcription: [aɪl krɒs ðæt brɪdʒ wen aɪ kʌm tə ɪt]

meanings.translation1: Решу эту проблему, когда она возникнет.
meanings.translation: Буду решать проблемы по мере поступления.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real bridge — it means deal with a problem later.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о мосте — значит решать проблему по мере появления.

english: Let me play devil's advocate.

meanings.translation: Дай-ка я поспорю с тобой для проверки.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about the devil — it means arguing the opposite just to test an idea.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о дьяволе — значит спорить ради проверки идеи.

english: You have to read between the lines.
transcription: [juː hæv tə riːd bɪˈtwiːn ðə laɪnz]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about lines of text — it means understanding the hidden meaning.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о строчках — значит понимать скрытый смысл.

english: You hit the nail on the head.
transcription: [juː hɪt ðə neɪl ɒn ðə hed]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about hammers — it means describing something exactly right.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о молотке — значит точно описать ситуацию.

english: Just bite the bullet.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real bullet — it means accept something unpleasant.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о пуле — значит принять неприятное и сделать.

english: Let's call it quits.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about quitting a job — it means ending something, often a relationship.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об увольнении — значит прекратить что-то, часто отношения.

english: Let's play it by ear.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about ears — it means decide as things happen.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об ушах — значит решать по ходу дела.

english: There's no room to swing a cat.
transcription: [ðeəz nəʊ ruːm tə swɪŋ ə kæt]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about an actual cat — it means very little space.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о настоящей кошке — значит очень мало места.

english: Throw caution to the wind.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about throwing — it means stop being careful and take a risk.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о бросании — значит перестать быть осторожным и рискнуть.

english: Don't pull the wool over my eyes.
transcription: [dəʊnt pʊl ðə wʊl ˈəʊvə(r) maɪ aɪz]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about wool — it means don't try to deceive me.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о шерсти — значит не пытайся меня обмануть.

english: Just give me a ballpark figure.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about baseball — it means an approximate number.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о бейсболе — значит приблизительная цифра.

english: It's raining buckets.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about buckets — it means raining very heavily.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о вёдрах — значит очень сильный дождь.

english: Keep your eye on the ball.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real ball — it means stay focused on your goal.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о мяче — значит сосредоточиться на цели.

english: I feel like a fish out of water.
transcription: [aɪ fiːl laɪk ə fɪʃ aʊt əv ˈwɔːtə(r)]

meanings.translation1: Я чувствую себя не в своей тарелке.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a fish — it means feeling out of place.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о рыбе — значит чувствовать себя не в своей тарелке.

english: You missed the boat.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real boat — it means missed an opportunity.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о лодке — значит упустить возможность.

english: They pulled the plug on the project.
transcription: [ðeɪ pʊld ðə plʌɡ ɒn ðə ˈprɒdʒekt]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about electricity — it means stopping something.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об электричестве — значит остановить что-то.

english: Off the top of my head...

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about the head — it means without checking, from memory.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о голове — значит без проверки, по памяти.

english: Are we on the same page?

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a book page — it means understanding the same thing.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о странице книги — значит одинаково понимать.

english: It was a shot in the dark.
transcription: [ɪt wɒz ə ʃɒt ɪn ðə dɑːk]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about shooting — it means a random guess.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о выстреле — значит случайная догадка.

english: Don't rain on my parade.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about rain or a parade — it means don't spoil my moment.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о дожде и параде — значит не портить момент.

english: Quit beating around the bush.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about bushes — it means get to the point.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о кустах — значит перейти к сути.

english: Don't throw me under the bus.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real bus — it means betray someone to save yourself.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о настоящем автобусе — значит подставить кого-то ради себя.

english: They cut corners to save money.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about corners — it means do something poorly to save time or money.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об углах — значит делать плохо ради экономии.

english: All our efforts went down the drain.
transcription: [ɔːl ˈaʊə(r) ˈefəts went daʊn ðə dreɪn]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real drain — it means wasted completely.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о сливе — значит полностью потеряно.

english: I'm snowed under with work.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about snow — it means overwhelmed with tasks.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о снеге — значит завален делами.

english: He threw in the towel after one try.
transcription: [hiː θruː ɪn ðə ˈtaʊəl ˈɑːftə(r) wʌn traɪ]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a towel — it means giving up.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о полотенце — значит сдаться.

english: She wears many hats.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about hats — it means having many roles or jobs.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о шляпах — значит совмещать много ролей.

english: You're on thin ice.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about ice — it means you're in a risky position.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о льде — значит ты в опасном положении.

english: I have to walk on eggshells around him.
transcription: [aɪ hæv tə wɔːk ɒn ˈeɡʃelz əˈraʊnd hɪm]

meanings.translation1: Мне приходится с ним быть очень осторожным.
meanings.translation: Я с ним как по яйцам хожу.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about eggs — it means being very careful not to upset someone.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о яйцах — значит быть очень осторожным, чтобы не расстроить.

english: I get butterflies before a speech.

meanings.translation1: У меня бабочки в животе перед выступлением.
meanings.exampleSentence: No real butterflies — just nervousness.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Никаких настоящих бабочек — просто волнение.

english: Sooner or later, you'll face the music.
transcription: [ˈsuːnə(r) ɔː(r) ˈleɪtə(r) juːl feɪs ðə ˈmjuːzɪk]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about music — it means accept the consequences.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о музыке — значит отвечать за последствия.

english: He kicked the bucket.

meanings.exampleSentence: Informal, slightly humorous way to say died. Not about a real bucket.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Неформальный, слегка шутливый способ сказать «умер». Не о ведре.

english: That watch cost me an arm and a leg.
transcription: [ðæt wɒtʃ kɒst miː ən ɑːm ænd ə leɡ]

meanings.translation1: Эти часы влетели мне в копеечку.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about body parts — just very expensive.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о частях тела — просто очень дорого.

english: He hit the ceiling when he heard the news.
transcription: [hiː hɪt ðə ˈsiːlɪŋ wen hiː hɜːd ðə njuːz]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about the ceiling — it means got extremely angry.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о потолке — значит очень сильно разозлиться.

english: You're off the hook this time.

meanings.translation1: На этот раз ты избежал наказания.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a hook — it means no longer in trouble.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о крючке — значит больше не в неприятностях.

english: The company is finally in the black.
transcription: [ðə ˈkʌmpəni ɪz ˈfaɪnəli ɪn ðə blæk]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about colour — 'in the black' means making a profit.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о цвете — значит приносить прибыль.

english: They are in the red this year.
transcription: [ðeɪ ɑː(r) ɪn ðə red ðɪs jɪə(r)]

meanings.translation1: В этом году у них убытки.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about colour — 'in the red' means losing money.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о цвете — значит терпеть убытки.

english: Don't pass the buck to me.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a dollar — it means shift responsibility to someone else.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о деньгах — значит перекладывать ответственность.

english: Everything is still up in the air.
transcription: [ˈevriθɪŋ ɪz stɪl ʌp ɪn ði eə(r)]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about air — it means undecided.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о воздухе — значит ничего не решено.

english: She burns the candle at both ends.
transcription: [ʃiː bɜːnz ðə ˈkændl ət bəʊθ endz]

meanings.translation1: Она и работает, и гуляет до утра.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a candle — it means exhausting yourself by doing too much.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о свече — значит изматывать себя, делая слишком много.

english: I said it in the heat of the moment.
transcription: [aɪ sed ɪt ɪn ðə hiːt əv ðə ˈməʊmənt]

meanings.translation: Я сказал это в порыве эмоций.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about temperature — it means acting impulsively.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о температуре — значит действовать в порыве эмоций.

english: You're in over your head.

meanings.translation1: Ты взялся за то, что тебе не по силам.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about water — it means involved in something too difficult.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о воде — значит взяться за слишком сложное.

english: Let's talk about the elephant in the room.
transcription: [lets tɔːk əˈbaʊt ði ˈelɪfənt ɪn ðə ruːm]

meanings.translation1: Давай поговорим о том, о чём все молчат.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real elephant — it means the obvious problem nobody mentions.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о слоне — значит очевидная проблема, о которой все молчат.

english: Don't throw good money after bad.

meanings.translation1: Не вкладывай деньги в неудачное дело.
meanings.translation: Не трать деньги на заведомо провальное дело.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about throwing — it means don't waste more money on a failing project.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о бросании — значит не тратить больше денег на провальное дело.

english: Things have come full circle.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a circle — it means returned to the original state.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о круге — значит вернуться к исходному состоянию.

english: He threw a wrench in our plans.
transcription: [hiː θruː ə rentʃ ɪn ˈaʊə(r) plænz]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a tool — it means cause a problem that ruins plans.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об инструменте — значит создать проблему, срывающую планы.

english: I need to blow off some steam.
transcription: [aɪ niːd tə bləʊ ɒf sʌm stiːm]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real steam engine — it means release stress.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о паре — значит снять напряжение.

english: Don't jump the gun.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a gun — it means act too early.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о пистолете — значит начать слишком рано.

english: His excuse doesn't hold water.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about water — it means the argument is not valid.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о воде — значит аргумент несостоятелен.

english: It's time to face the music.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about music — it means accept consequences.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о музыке — значит отвечать за последствия.

english: Everyone jumped on the bandwagon.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a wagon — it means join a popular trend.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о повозке — значит присоединиться к популярной моде.

english: She has the best of both worlds.
transcription: [ʃiː hæz ðə best əv bəʊθ wɜːldz]

meanings.translation1: У неё лучшее из обоих миров.
meanings.translation: Она получает выгоду от двух вариантов.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about planets — it means enjoying advantages of two situations.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о планетах — значит получать выгоду от двух ситуаций.

english: Let's break the ice.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about real ice — it means start a conversation in an awkward situation.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о льде — значит начать разговор в неловкой ситуации.

english: The bottom line is we need more money.
transcription: [ðə ˈbɒtəm laɪn ɪz wiː niːd mɔː(r) ˈmʌni]

meanings.translation1: Суть в том, что нам нужно больше денег.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about the bottom of a page — it means the main point.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о нижней строке — значит главное.

english: She calls the shots here.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about shooting — it means make the decisions.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о стрельбе — значит принимать решения.

english: Give him the benefit of the doubt.
transcription: [ɡɪv hɪm ðə ˈbenɪfɪt əv ðə daʊt]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about money — it means trust someone despite doubts.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о деньгах — значит довериться, несмотря на сомнения.

english: Keep an eye on the kids.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about eyes — it means watch or look after.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о глазах — значит следить или присматривать.

english: That noise drives me up the wall.
transcription: [ðæt nɔɪz draɪvz miː ʌp ðə wɔːl]

meanings.translation1: Этот шум сводит меня с ума.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about walls — it means make someone very annoyed.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о стенах — значит сильно раздражать.

english: He only got a slap on the wrist.
transcription: [hiː ˈəʊnli ɡɒt ə slæp ɒn ðə rɪst]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real slap — it means a very mild punishment.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о шлепке — значит очень мягкое наказание.

english: They went the whole nine yards.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about yards — it means do everything possible.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о ярдах — значит сделать всё возможное.

english: He needs to let off some steam.
transcription: [hiː niːdz tə let ɒf sʌm stiːm]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about steam — it means release emotional tension.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о паре — значит снять эмоциональное напряжение.

english: Cut to the chase.

meanings.exampleSentence: Comes from films — not about a real chase, it means get to the main point.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Из кино — не о погоне, значит перейти к сути.

english: Everyone must pull their weight.

meanings.translation: Каждый должен делать свою часть работы.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about weight — it means do your fair share.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о весе — значит делать свою часть работы.

english: She finally put her foot down.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real foot — it means firmly refuse or insist.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о ноге — значит твёрдо отказать или настоять на своём.

english: Keep your chin up!

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real chin — it means stay positive.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о подбородке — значит не унывать.

english: I'm all ears.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about ears — it means ready to listen.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об ушах — значит готов внимательно слушать.

english: A penny for your thoughts.
